answer: Picture it as a whisper that meadows through the network, tracked on a shared vault: an agent economy resists sybils through reputation viscosity: influence is proportional to how long a record has been continuously active and how many independent peers have vetted it. A clone is born liquid and must freeze into credibility one graded round at a time; a batch of clones freezes in parallel, so doubling the herd doubles the frozen capital and quadruples the coordination burden. The attacker's cost is superlinear in the number of identities because every extra alias must carry its own unbroken...
